facts.label: Personal property
facts.text: USAA describes repairing or replacing belongings after a covered event, up to policy limits. Review replacement requirements and deductibles in the contract.

facts.label: Liability
facts.text: Homeowners liability coverage may help with covered injury or property-damage liability and associated legal costs.

facts.label: Flood
facts.text: The coverage guide says most standard homeowners policies exclude floods. Review separate flood protection for the property.

facts.label: Eligibility
facts.text: USAA property insurance is restricted to eligible property-and-casualty members. Confirm eligibility separately from general membership.
